description.zh: 项目空间下分配的按量部分资源上限。
description.en: Upper limit of pay-as-you-go resources allocated to the project.

description.zh: 项目空间下分配的包年包月资源的大小。
description.en: Size of subscription resources allocated to the project.

description.zh: 项目空间是否为同城高可用。
description.en: Specifies whether the project is configured for high availability (HA) within the same region.

title.zh: 修改项目空间的资源配置
title.en: Modify the resource configuration of a project

descriptions.zh: >调用该接口时，需要注意以下几点： - 订单状态必须是正常状态，即OrderType=NORMAL。- 降配时，填写的资源规格数量不可小于已使用的资源规格数量。变更前后的项目资源规格详情请通过[DescribeNamespaces](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/323441.html)。
descriptions.en: > When you call this API, note the following: The order status must be Normal (OrderType=NORMAL). When you downgrade, the specified resource quota cannot be less than the quota already in use. For details about project resource specifications before and after the change, see [DescribeNamespaces](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/323441.html).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun foasconsole modify-namespace-spec-v2 --biz-region cn-beijing --instance-id f-cn-wwo36qj0000 --namespace di-59343944380000 --guaranteed-resource-spec Cpu=10 MemoryGB=40 --elastic-resource-spec Cpu=6 MemoryGB=52 --ha false --api-version 2021-10-28 --region cn-hangzhou
